FAQs

Frequently Asked Questions

To help you get the information you need quickly, we've compiled a list of frequently asked questions. If you don't find the answer you're looking for, please feel free to contact us directly.

Updated on November 04, 2025

What services does Wugweb offer?

Wugweb offers a comprehensive range of services including Brand & Strategy, Experience Design, Martech & Gen AI, Web Development, QA & Testing, and No-Code Development.

What makes your UI/UX design services stand out?

Our UI/UX design services are rooted in user-centered design, combining human-centered design principles with strategic focus on customer experience and end-to-end user journey design.

Do you provide custom brand identity design and positioning?

Yes, as a brand strategy consulting agency, we craft transformative brand experiences including brand identity design, brand narrative development, and comprehensive brand positioning and strategy.

What kind of platforms do you develop under web and app development?

We build responsive websites, ecommerce platforms, and custom web applications using full-stack development, CMS integration, and mobile-first design.

How do you integrate MarTech and AI into your services?

We blend digital experience strategy with AI-powered marketing and generative AI, helping brands automate, personalize, and optimize user journeys across channels.

Do you offer no-code development for fast launch?

Yes, we empower businesses to launch digital products faster through no-code solutions including Webflow, Bubble, Outsystems, and Mendix development.

How do your QA and testing services ensure product quality?

Our QA services safeguard digital products through rigorous functional testing, usability testing, and performance testing to ensure the highest standards of quality and reliability.

What is the typical timeline for a project?

Timelines vary by scope. A typical brand strategy engagement runs 4-8 weeks, while web development projects range from 8-16 weeks depending on complexity.

How do you charge for your services?

We offer project-based pricing for defined scopes and retainer-based partnerships for ongoing work. Contact us for a custom proposal tailored to your needs.

Do you work with startups?

Yes, we work with companies of all sizes — from early-stage startups to enterprise organizations. Our Start Smart, Start Small approach is designed for growing businesses.

Still have questions?

We're here to help. Reach out and we'll get back to you promptly.
